meta.name: company-finder
meta.description: Translates an ICP definition into a step-by-step guide for identifying target companies in lemlist using signals, triggers, and firmographic filters. Use when asked "find me companies to target", "how do I find accounts in lemlist", "build a company list", "which companies match my ICP", "how to use lemlist signals to find prospects", or after list-builder routes to account-level targeting. Produces a pedagogical, step-by-step signal and filter guide.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将理想客户画像转化为可执行的客户搜索指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要根据理想客户画像在lemlist中精准找到目标公司。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your ideal customer profile into a step-by-step guide for finding target companies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find target companies in lemlist based on your ideal customer profile.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 lemlist 账户识别专家。它能将你的理想客户画像（ICP）转化为一步步的操作指南，教你如何用 lemlist 的筛选条件和信号来找到匹配的公司，并解释每个配置的理由。
howto.when: 当你要求“找目标公司”、“建立公司列表”、“匹配 ICP”或“如何用 lemlist 信号找客户”时触发；也可能会在列表生成器转向账户级定位后介入。

say.text: 帮我找到适合我们产品的目标公司。
say.note: Claude 会询问 ICP 细节并生成配置步骤。

say.text: 如何利用 lemlist 的信号找到潜在客户？
say.note: Claude 会结合公司过滤器与信号给出组合策略。

say.text: 我的理想客户是 50-200 人的 B2B SaaS，刚融资。
say.note: Claude 会输出具体的公司搜索配置指南。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a lemlist account targeting specialist. It translates an Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) into a step-by-step guide for using lemlist's signals and company filters to identify matching accounts, with reasoning for each configuration choice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find target companies, build a company list, match ICP, or use lemlist signals for prospecting. Also routes after list-builder moves to account-level targeting.

say_en.text: Help me find companies that fit our product.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about ICP and generate config steps.

say_en.text: How to use lemlist signals to find prospects?
say_en.note: Claude will explain combining filters and signals.

say_en.text: My ICP is B2B SaaS, 50-200 employees, just funded.
say_en.note: Claude will output a tailored company search guide.
